appDescription: A family car app that prepares seats for a baby car seat and watches over the baby during the trip.

function.name: PREPARE_DEPARTURE
function.description: Plan car seat placement, seat positions and cargo space for the next trip with a baby, then show the plan for confirmation.

seniors.description: Number of elderly passengers, not counting the driver.

adults.description: Number of other adult passengers, not counting the driver or elderly passengers.

children.description: Number of children who sit in a booster seat.

infants.description: Number of babies who ride in a car seat.

babyBags.description: Number of baby bags or diaper bags to load.

portableCribs.description: Number of portable cribs to load.

otherBags.description: Number of other bags or boxes to load.

function.name: REPORT_BABY_STATE
function.description: Record the current state of the baby in the rear car seat so the car can adjust guidance and stops.

function.name: ACCEPT_CAR_SUGGESTION
function.description: Accept what the car app is suggesting right now. It applies the suggested care for the baby, or adds a rest area with a nursing room on the route as a waypoint.

choice.description: Position of the suggested rest area to add, starting from one. Omit it to accept the first suggestion.
